q: In March 2025, what multiplier was paid for day D2 work in hour band H2? Answer under the version of the overtime rate that was in force on that date.
log:
In March 2025, the version of the overtime rate in force was `hard-overtime-v2` (effective 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31). For day D2, hour band H2, the multiplier was **1.35x**.
